title: Pan-Seared Callaloo with Braised Greens
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish that combines the tender callaloo with the rich braised greens.

ingredients.name: Braised greens (such as wilted, dutch, callaloo)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes, until softened.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the chopped callaloo and braised greens to the skillet, and sauté for 4-5 minutes, until wilted.
Season with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Serve the callaloo mixture hot, garnished with additional braised greens if desired.
